description: Airtable is a cloud platform for building collaborative databases, workflows, interfaces, and automations. It lets teams store structured data in bases and access or manipulate that data through APIs and AI-tool integrations.
summary: Airtable exposes a token-authenticated REST Web API at api.airtable.com, an OAuth/PAT-authenticated MCP server at mcp.airtable.com/mcp, and an official `airtable-mcp` CLI for terminal access to MCP tools.
